race.comment: MARINERA (2) was backed from $1.50 into $1.30 but only scored by a narrow margin when returning from a brief spell over 1000m at Warren last start. Lightly raced mare with great scope for improvement. Can take this next step with that first-up run under her belt. Another last start maiden winner in BEES KNEES (4) looks a threat. Lined up for only the second time when she opened her account with authority over 1000m at Quirindi a month ago. Beautifully drawn and certainly looks up to winning a race like this. WOOTTON PLEASE (7) tired late to finish fourth when fresh from a seven-week let-up over 1200m at Coonabarabran recently. Fitter this time and the addition of a tongue tie could be significant. Likely improver. TIYE (5) has been run off her legs in the early stages of late. Handy sprinter who may benefit from the blinkers going on today. HANUMAN (3) has been about the money at his last couple and did win here at his only visit.
